name: Extended Side Angle Pose
description: Wide-legged lunge with the forearm or hand down and the top arm reaching over the ear.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Stand with your feet wide apart; turn your front foot out and your back foot slightly in.
Bend your front knee over the ankle, arms out to the sides.

keyframes.name: Step wide
keyframes.cue: Step the feet wide apart, arms out to the sides.

keyframes.name: Extended Side Angle Pose
keyframes.cue: Bend the right knee, lower the right hand, reach the left arm overhead.

cues: Keep the front knee over the ankle.
Make one line from back heel to fingertips.
